text: The largest tree-cover loss event recorded on the property was in 2020, with a loss of 67.7 hectares. This event is identified by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) as a significant loss before the 2020-12-31 baseline. The property had an initial tree cover of 23.0 hectares in 2000. The European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 data shows no forest cover remaining in 2020.
